name: Novant Health Charlotte Marathon 2026 (Health & Wellness Expo)
why: Charlotte's marathon runs Nov 14, 2026, with a Health and Wellness Expo presented by Fleet Feet on Fri Nov 13 at the Charlotte Convention Center (10am-7pm). Axios reported in Jan 2026 that CSF bought the race from RunCharlotte, so the 2026 expo is being sold by a new owner that is building it out.
why_now: Expo 2026-11-13, race 2026-11-14; about five weeks out, so ask now for a late table or 2027 exhibitor slot
ask: Ask CSF whether an expo table is still available for Nov 13, and if not, how to get on the 2027 exhibitor list
opener: Hi CSF team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band runners wear overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, with an open SDK. I saw the Health and Wellness Expo is Nov 13 at the Convention Center. Is there still room for a small exhibitor table this year? If not, I'd like to be first in line for 2027.

name: Martin Marietta City of Oaks Marathon 2026
why: Raleigh's marathon and half, listed for Nov 1, 2026 with about 7,000 estimated attendees. Martin Marietta holds title naming rights through the 2026 event, and past sponsors include Pendo and Rex Healthcare, so the race sells sponsor tiers to Triangle companies. The race has run a packet-pickup expo with dozens of vendors in past years.
why_now: Race 2026-11-01; title deal runs through 2026, so 2027 sponsor tiers will be reset after this race
ask: Ask whether the 2026 packet-pickup expo has vendor space, and what the 2027 entry sponsor tier looks like
opener: Hi City of Oaks team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We build a screenless overnight band that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, and we're looking for Raleigh runners to wear early units. Does your Nov 1 packet pickup take vendors? If this year is full, I'd like to talk about a small 2027 sponsor spot.

name: Tobacco Road Marathon Weekend 2027
why: Cary's marathon weekend is listed for March 12-14, 2027 with an in-person race expo where partner charities run info tables. Altra has held half-marathon title sponsorship before, so the race sells named tiers; it is a Triangle nonprofit race with a long training cycle that starts this winter.
why_now: Race weekend 2027-03-12 to 2027-03-14; sponsor and expo plans are typically set over the winter
ask: Ask the race for its 2027 expo vendor terms and whether it would let Vybe run a training-block wear pilot with a small group of entrants
opener: Hi Tobacco Road team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. Your runners train through the winter for March, and we'd like a few of them to wear early units during the block. Do you sell expo tables for 2027, and who should I talk to about a small partnership?

name: Asheville Marathon & Half 2027
why: Boston-qualifying, USATF-certified race in March 2027; the race page lists the expo on Fri March 19, 2027 (11am-7pm) at Embassy Suites Asheville Downtown. The 2026 race was hosted by iDaph Events and sponsored by New Belgium Brewing, so a small brand can still get noticed there.
ask: Ask iDaph Events for 2027 expo vendor pricing
opener: Hi iDaph team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless overnight band that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, with an open developer SDK. I saw the 2027 Asheville expo moves to Embassy Suites on March 19. Do you sell vendor tables, and what does one cost? We'd bring units for runners to try on.

name: Novant Health Wilmington NC Marathon 2027
why: Wilmington's point-to-point marathon from Wrightsville Beach to downtown, listed for late Feb 2027, with a runners expo at the Wilmington Convention Center. WECT reported 5,000+ athletes expected in 2025, and the race already sells presenting, 5K and 1-mile sponsorships (Wicked Weed, Truist, Fleet Feet).
why_now: Race listed 2027-02-27/28; expo vendor decisions fall over the holidays
ask: Ask Without Limits for 2027 expo vendor terms
opener: Hi Without Limits team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band runners wear overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. We'd like to meet Wilmington runners at the 2027 expo. Do you have vendor space for February, and who handles it?

name: Tough as Trails Off-Road Race Series 2026-27
why: Durham running store's three-race trail series: Eno River Run (Oct 25, 2026), Uwharrie Mountain Run (Feb 6, 2027, up to 40 miles) and Mountains-to-Sea Trail Challenge (Apr 11, 2027, up to 50K). Series runners must finish all three, which makes a six-month cohort that fits an overnight-recovery wear test. The store lists community@bullcityrunning.com.
ask: Offer 5-10 bands to series runners for the Eno-to-MST block, and ask about a product table at Uwharrie in Feb
opener: Hi Bull City Running, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. Your Tough as Trails series runs Eno to Uwharrie to MST, which is a perfect training block to wear it through. Could we offer 5-10 series runners early units, and maybe set up a table at Uwharrie?

warm_path: Marine Raider / MARSOC community at Camp Lejeune
name: Tideland 24 (24-hour ultra benefiting Marine Raider Foundation)
why: 24-hour loop ultra on the Tideland Trail in Croatan National Forest near Camp Lejeune, Sat Nov 7, 2026. Proceeds go to the Marine Raider Foundation, it partners with the MILES FOR MARSOC athlete program and gives a top active-duty award, so the race draws the Marine and special-operations community.
ask: Offer in-kind support (bands for a few runners plus an aid-station donation) and ask about 2027 sponsorship
opener: Hi Tideland 24 team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. A 24-hour race for the Marine Raider Foundation is exactly the community we want to support. Could we donate to an aid station and offer a few runners early units for the weeks around the race? Happy to talk 2027 too.

name: Fort Bragg Family & MWR Sponsorship and Advertising
why: Fort Bragg MWR sells commercial sponsorship for sports and fitness events, single-soldier programs and special events; sponsors get a tent/table at events, logo placement and an account manager. Its FY26 rate card lists facility ad campaigns at $6,000 (3 months) and $14,000 (6 months) and cites 250,000+ Soldiers, Families, Retirees and Civilians.
why_now: FY26 rate card is live; fitness event sponsorship is the low-cost entry
opportunity: Sponsor one MWR sports and fitness event (e.g., the All American Races) for a table in front of soldiers, instead of paid facility ads
unknowns: Event sponsorship prices are not on the rate card; DoD commercial-sponsorship rules may limit product claims and sampling
ask: Ask the MWR sponsorship office for the price of a single fitness-event sponsorship with a table
opener: Hi Fort Bragg MWR sponsorship team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, and it has no screen to take off for duty. I'd like to sponsor one of your fitness events with a table. What would a single-event package cost, and which events are open for 2027?

name: All American Races (Half Marathon and 5K) 2027
why: Fort Bragg MWR's annual half marathon and 5K, listed for March 21, 2027 in Fayetteville; past years were expected to reach registration capacity. Sponsorship runs through Fort Bragg MWR's commercial sponsorship office, which offers event tents/tables.
why_now: Race 2027-03-21; sponsors usually sign before registration opens in winter
ask: Ask MWR for an expo/finish-area sponsor table at the 2027 All American Races
opener: Hi, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless overnight band that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. opener: Hi MCCS sponsorship team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. I'd like to sponsor a 2027 Semper Fi Grand Prix race or the Marine Corps Half with a table. Could you send the race sponsorship options and prices?

name: 2nd MLG Human Performance Center (Camp Lejeune)
why: 2nd Marine Logistics Group opened a Human Performance Center on Camp Lejeune on Feb 15, 2024 to integrate Marine Corps Total Fitness; a Dec 2024 update reported nearly 800 participants a month, and it runs a 12-week program with physical assessments. No wearable is mentioned, so recovery tracking is an open gap.
why_now: Program is running at ~800 participants a month (Dec 2024 update)
opportunity: Offer HPC staff DevKit units to evaluate overnight HRV/resting HR during their 12-week program (staff evaluation, not a procurement)
unknowns: No public HPC contact; any device use needs command and privacy approval; procurement route unknown

opener: Hi, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, with no screen and an open data API. I read about the 2nd MLG Human Performance Center. Could I have 15 minutes with your staff to learn how you track recovery now, and whether a staff evaluation of a few units would be useful?

opener: Hi FBRI team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We're building a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, with raw data access through a licensed SDK. I read that Geneva tests wearables with units. Could we have 15 minutes to learn what you look for in a device, and whether a DevKit unit would be useful?

name: North Carolina Sheriffs' Association Corporate Partners
why: NCSA runs statewide purchasing programs for sheriffs' offices and says Corporate Partners and Sponsors get exclusive exposure to North Carolina's sheriffs, with conference sponsorships (banquet, coffee break, welcome bag) at its annual training conference. Deputies and detention staff work rotating shifts, which is the use case for a no-screen overnight band.
opportunity: Become a small corporate partner or conference sponsor to reach sheriffs' wellness leads statewide
unknowns: Current partner pricing not published (sponsor menus found are from 2015-16); next annual conference date not found

opener: Hi NCSA team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, built for shift workers who can't wear a watch on duty. Could you send the current corporate partner levels and the date of your next annual training conference?

An event listing checked 2026-09-19 gives Aug 11-14, 2027. Firefighters on 24-hour shifts are a core use case for a screenless overnight band.

opener: Hi NCSFA team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, built for firefighters on 24-hour shifts who can't wear a watch on calls. Could you send the SAFRE 2027 exhibitor prospectus and booth pricing?

why: Nonprofit adult rugby club that lost its Poole Road pitch to an NC DOT eminent-domain purchase in Oct 2024 and is fundraising for a new facility with monthly supporter tiers ($25-$200). A club looking for support is open to a small in-kind partner, and rugby players carry heavy contact load.

opener: Hi Raleigh Rugby, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. We'd like to support the club while you rebuild: a donation to the pitch fund plus five early units for players to wear through the season. Who's the right person to talk to?

ask: Seed 5 bands to club players in the Anthem development pathway for a season
opener: Hi Hanna, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. opener: Hi Charlotte Strength, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate. name: Newbreed Raleigh Winter Championship 2026
why: BJJ tournament listed for Dec 12, 2026 in Raleigh with registration open (2024 edition at the NC State Fairgrounds). Grapplers cutting weight and competing on weekends are a fit for overnight resting-HR and HRV, and regional BJJ events take small vendors.

opener: Hi Newbreed, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, so it never touches the mat. Do you offer vendor tables at the Dec 12 Raleigh Winter Championship, and what do they cost?

why: Dunn's lab builds digital biomarkers from wearables, studies wearable accuracy across skin tones (npj Digital Medicine), leads the open-source Digital Biomarker Discovery Pipeline, and holds a 2024 NSF CAREER award ($597,774) on bias and drift in wearable biosignal algorithms. Raw ECG-based HRV with an SDK is directly useful to that work.

opener: Hi Dr. Dunn, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We're building a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, with raw data through a licensed SDK. Your work on wearable accuracy and algorithm drift is exactly the scrutiny we want. Would your lab evaluate a DevKit unit and tell us where it falls short?

org: NSF ASSIST Engineering Research Center, NC State University
why: NC State-led NSF center focused on always-on wearables: low-power sensors, energy harvesting, ultra-low-power electronics and smart textiles, with cardiovascular health as a use case. Industry members get facility access, IP access, reduced sponsored-research rates and a vote on research through the Industry Advisory Board.

opener: Hi ASSIST team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We're building a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, and battery life is our hardest problem. Your low-power wearable work is a close fit. Could we have 15 minutes to learn how the affiliate membership works for an early-stage hardware company?

Would you share our DevKit call with your hardware and device tenants, and could we visit Hangar6?

opener: Hi RIoT team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. We're building a screenless overnight band that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, with a licensed SDK for developers.
